notes.title: Patch Notes v2.02
notes.content:
Patch notes

Features

Added new playable character to the game, including combat animations, new classes and skills to unlock.
Added quest log for all existing main story quest and side quests in the game.
Added new zone: Voedeford filled with new NPCs, monsters, quests, tickle scenes, and character interaction.
Lucia now has voice acting lines throughout the game.
Two new tickling scenes include simple sprite animations.
New 'Game over' sequence unlocked if player is defeated by orcs.
Added two new pinups to accompany new Voedeford content.
Added gallery unlock feature for the pinups unlocked in the game so players can see them in game.
Replaced Enchantress artwork with something hand drawn by the original artist of the game/comics.
Previously learned skills in the Skill point spend window are now hidden to declutter the UI.
Added five new magical, non-set items in new Voedeford content.
Added one new set of armor to craft in new Voedeford content.
Improved "Wind Rider" stats.
Improved "Laughing Bolt" stats.
New cut scene after main villain defeat.
Added two memory stones to accommodate new Voedeford content expansion.
Added animated dragon pack to game.
Added animated orc pack to game.
Added creepy eldritch type foes pack to game.
Added mountain foes pack to game.
Added new cut scene after the Crystal is taken from Lucia in Meadowsbrook.
Reduce number of war beads needed to complete "Halting their advance" side quest from 10 to 6.
Reduce direct damage component in Bavol's "Wave of Poison" line of spells.
Reduced frequency of random combat in the Valley of the Fjon.
Improved and cleaned up dialogue among NPCs in the Red Crystal church.
Reduced frequency of random combat in second Emerald Forest zone.
Improved and standardized amount of skill points awarded for completing main story quest steps.





Bugs

Vice's portrait wasn't showing up properly in the Elvan camp.
Misspelling in the volcano with the phoenix.
Fixed collision issue where players could walk on the ceiling in the underground passage.
Fixed bust images in the Princess war room scene.
Misspelling in conversation with Dreche in Castle Beaumont.
Fixed bust graphics issue after Clarissa and Professor scene.
Moved "Mass Spell Enhancement" to abilities instead of magic.
Fixed game note that said player needed to talk to Katrine in the Silver Coast after doing so.
Fixed bust graphics in Princess Memory Stone.
Fixed crash bug in Meadowbrooke.
Fixed treasure chest bug in Ssrishakk's tower.
Fixed collision detection issue for Castle Beautmont gates.
Fixed quest rewards for completing fairy quest in the Emerald forest.
Fixed duplicate cut scene with Aunt Kelli.
Misspelling in Arabeth's transformation cut scene.
Removed reference to Clarissa in the Aedylon Moors when she's not with the party yet.
Fixed bug indicating a building in the Fjon was Lucia's house.
Fixed bug in main menu.
Misspelling in Red Crystal absorption scene.
Fixed exit of Dralmar and Hollow Man in the Western Cave.
Misspelling in Western cave.
Misspelling in Fallung dialogue.
Misspelling in meeting with the Fjon.
Misspelling in Clarissa interaction.
Fixed bug including Bavol, the final fight, and the epilogue content.
